item_counts.basis: independent course-level audit; normalized report totals are retained below

coverage_gaps.detail: Catalog manifest and current build manifest each contain the same ordered 28 unit IDs; the two reports partition those IDs into 14 plus 14 with no missing or duplicate report units.
After normalizing result/status and practice_id/item_id/id, all 139 reported item IDs are unique within their units and match the active 03-practice-flow item IDs for all 28 units.
All 349 reported source anchors resolve to current unit chunks; every reported per-unit source_chunk_count also matches the current chunks.jsonl record count.

The expected 28 direct unit directories each contain active practice artifacts, but the current build also has a stray immediate directory named units/ucb-cs188-spring-2026 containing a nested units/lecture-10 directory with no practice artifacts. This is structural and does not add a scanned unit.

items.finding: The active 03 and final 05 introduce vector z=(2,-1) and then ask for scalar z=0.2 and z=-0.2 without defining the relationship; the cited chunks support the neuron input/output and activation concepts but do not repair the missing input definition.
取货/等待 has no transition consequences, risk or delay values, objective comparison, or observable success criterion, so neither action nor the requested reason is falsifiable.
Routes A/B provide steps and visibility only; no cost/risk model, decision objective, feedback, belief variable, or update rule determines the requested choice or planning/learning result.
The crossword intersection position supplies no letter or 2-Down candidate constraint, so the candidate sets cannot be uniquely filtered; the components are named but the required input is absent.

The finite MAX/MIN tree, order, values, alpha/beta state, prune test, and root result are observable and transferable.
The three-state MDP, transitions, rewards, terminal convention, gamma boundary, and V0 convention are self-contained and aligned.
The question asks the learner to reproduce the exact P(B|j,m) four-term expansion and repeated-factor observation shown on pages 20-21; no changed setting or new inference is required.
The 03 item is the exact page-15/16 P(B|j,m), A-then-E trace; the final 05 item further omits the factor list/graph needed to solve it without replaying the lecture.
Explicitly labeled teaching transfer with a complete two-state trellis, transition/observation weights, sum/max comparison, and observable recurrences.

Top-1, Top-1000, full-pipeline success, stage failure, and closed/open-book remeasurement are numerically checkable and stage-aligned.

independently_confirmed_findings.repair_rule: Replace lecture-owned numbers, names, tables, or exact worked-example states with a new solvable setting or a materially changed condition; restate every necessary input and require a checkable transfer result.

repair_priority.action: Repair the Practice prompt/checkpoint with all inputs, states, transitions or constraints, objective/selection rule, and observable result. For lecture-23 remove or define the vector/scalar mismatch; for lecture-27 add action consequences and a decision criterion; for lecture-28/p1 add route risk/cost, feedback, belief/update data, and output; for lecture-28/p2 give the missing crossing letter or complete candidate constraint. Re-audit both 03 and 05.

Create a fresh, non-copy setting or a meaningful condition change that tests the same concept. Keep lecture variables only when all conditions are restated and the learner must perform a new judgment/derivation/prediction; do not ask to recalculate or reproduce a cited page's exact answer.

Restore the factor definitions, graph/query conditions, and a task-specific evidence/evaluation contract in the final 05 artifact while preserving learner-facing privacy boundaries; then compare 03, 05, and citations before independent re-audit.

Resolve the deferred structural findings below, remove or quarantine the stray nested directory, create a new fingerprinted build for any artifact change, and rerun deterministic structural validation plus the independent semantic scan.
